description: Phase 2: Project Management — Students can manage all their trend projects from a dashboard. Create, rename, delete, and navigate into each project's dedicated workspace. Depends on Phase 1 (ralph/phase-1-foundation) being complete.

userStories.title: Define Prisma schema with Project and Message models, cascade delete, and composite index
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the full Prisma schema in place so the database can store projects and their messages with correct cascade-delete and query-performance characteristics.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace the stub model in `prisma/schema.prisma` with two models: `Project` (id String @id @default(cuid()), name String, createdAt DateTime @default(now()), updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt, messages Message[]) and `Message` (id String @id @default(cuid()), projectId String, role String, content String, createdAt DateTime @default(now()), project Project @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade))
Add `@@index([projectId, createdAt])` to the Message model
Run `npx prisma migrate dev --name add-project-and-message-models` — migration completes without errors
Run `npx prisma generate` — client regenerates without errors
Verify `prisma/migrations/` contains a new folder named with timestamp and `add_project_and_message_models`
`npx tsc --noEmit` passes

userStories.title: Implement project CRUD Route Handlers with Zod validation and force-dynamic
userStories.description: As a developer, I need REST API endpoints for project CRUD so the dashboard UI can create, list, rename, and delete projects through well-typed, validated handlers.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/app/api/projects/route.ts` — exports `GET` (list all projects sorted by `updatedAt` desc) and `POST` (create project); both import `prisma` from `@/lib/prisma`
`route.ts` has `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` at the top to prevent GET route caching
POST handler validates request body with Zod: `z.object({ name: z.string().min(1).max(100) })` — returns 400 with `{ error }` message on invalid input
Create `src/app/api/projects/[id]/route.ts` — exports `GET` (single project by id), `PATCH` (rename, Zod-validated), `DELETE` (delete project by id)
All handlers return `NextResponse.json(...)` with appropriate HTTP status codes (200, 201, 400, 404)
GET `/api/projects` returns a JSON array; POST `/api/projects` with body `{"name":"Test Project"}` returns `{ id, name, createdAt, updatedAt }` with status 201
DELETE `/api/projects/[id]` on a non-existent id returns 404
`npx tsc --noEmit` passes

userStories.title: Build the project dashboard Server Component that renders the initial project list
userStories.description: As a student, I need a dashboard page that shows all my trend projects when I open the app so I can see what I've been working on at a glance.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace `src/app/page.tsx` with a Server Component (no `'use client'` directive) that queries Prisma directly: `prisma.project.findMany({ orderBy: { updatedAt: 'desc' } })`
Import `prisma` from `@/lib/prisma`
Renders a list of project names; if no projects exist, displays an empty state message such as 'No projects yet'
Page title reads 'FUND II Trend Mapper' (e.g. in an `<h1>`)
`npm run build` completes without errors (static analysis must pass)
`npx tsc --noEmit` passes

userStories.title: Build project card component with create, rename, and delete interactions using optimistic UI
userStories.description: As a student, I need to create new projects, rename existing ones, and delete projects I no longer need — all without a full page reload — so the dashboard feels fast and responsive.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/components/ProjectCard.tsx` as a Client Component (`'use client'`) that accepts a `project: { id: string; name: string; updatedAt: string }` prop
Card displays the project name and an 'Open' link pointing to `/projects/[id]`
Card has a 'Rename' affordance (button or inline edit) that PATCHes `/api/projects/[id]` with `{ name }` and updates the UI without a full reload
Card has a 'Delete' button that shows a confirmation step (e.g. 'Are you sure?') before sending DELETE to `/api/projects/[id]` and removing the card from the list optimistically
Create `src/components/CreateProjectForm.tsx` as a Client Component with a text input and 'Create' button that POSTs `{ name }` to `/api/projects` and appends the new project to the list on success
Dashboard `page.tsx` renders `<CreateProjectForm />` above the project list and passes each project to `<ProjectCard />`
No full page reload occurs for any of the three interactions (create, rename, delete)
`npx tsc --noEmit` passes

userStories.title: Build project routing with /projects/[projectId] page, not-found handling, and back navigation
userStories.description: As a student, I need to navigate into a project's dedicated page when I click 'Open' so I have a workspace for that project's chat (placeholder at this stage).
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/app/projects/[projectId]/page.tsx` as a Server Component that accepts `params: { projectId: string }`
Page fetches the project from Prisma: `prisma.project.findUnique({ where: { id: projectId } })`
If project is not found, calls Next.js `notFound()` (imported from `next/navigation`) to render the 404 page

If found, renders the project name in an `

` and a placeholder section such as `

Chat coming in Phase 3

`
Includes a back-navigation link: `<Link href='/'>← Back to Dashboard</Link>` (using `next/link`)
Create `src/app/projects/[projectId]/not-found.tsx` with a user-friendly 'Project not found' message and a link back to the dashboard
Clicking 'Open' on a ProjectCard navigates to `/projects/[id]` and displays the correct project name
`npx tsc --noEmit` passes
`npm run build` completes without errors
